cases.name: Vantazia Campbell
cases.about:
Vantazia enrolled in North Carolina A&T State University in 2017, majoring in criminal justice. McNair said her daughter had to take a break due to kidney failure.Her family added that she re-enrolled in 2023 after getting a kidney and was set to graduate this fall. North Carolina A&T State University awarded a posthumous degree during graduation ceremonies. Campbell's mother, Tanya McNeil, and sister, Janasia Johnson, attended the graduation ceremony and accepted the degree on Campbell's behalf. They're thankful for the university in helping to fulfill Campbell's dream, but wish she were here to see it become a reality.

"That was her goal to finish college and to make a better life for herself," said McNair.

The family said Campbell's degree is proudly displayed in their home.

They've also started a foundation to help raise awareness for domestic violence.
